audit.why: Ranged poke lane a dashless tank survives rather than wins: Jayce owns 1-5 on gate-Q, flattens at 6 when Glacial Prison lands, and Sejuani takes over on tank items. 50.51% over 390 games fits.

Sides match the already-audited mirror (audits/top/sejuani__jayce.json): Jayce levels 1-5, Skill at 6 because Glacial Prison reaches 1300 while Shock Blast casts from 600, items left as-written near even. Not re-sided so the two directions stay consistent.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] and whys[2] call it 'her Frost passive'. Her passive is Fury of the North; the Frost STACKS come from Winter's Wrath and arm Permafrost (E). And the page never states that Fury of the North's Frost Armor grants immunity to slows, which cancels the slow on To the Skies! (Q).
audit.why: Wrong ability name is the calibration-list error class. The slow immunity is the decisive interaction: your only slow does nothing to her walk-up while Frost Armor holds, so the hammer leap is burst, not kiting.
audit.corrected: Name Fury of the North / Frost Armor correctly and state the slow immunity against To the Skies!.

audit.whatIsWrong: tldr, winCon and focus all name Permafrost as the cooldown to track. Permafrost is a 1.5-second cooldown that only fires at max Frost stacks — there is no window to play around.
audit.why: The punishable cooldown is Arctic Assault (Q) at 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s; Winter's Wrath is 9/8/7/6/5s and Glacial Prison 120/105/90s. Telling a player to track a 1.5s ability teaches nothing.
audit.corrected: tldr and winCon now track Arctic Assault's 18s.

edits.before: Bully him early — gate-poke him out and hammer the Permafrost dive. Jayce wins the Permafrost cooldown windows.
edits.after: Bully her early — gate-poke her out and hammer the Arctic Assault dive. Jayce wins the 18s Arctic Assault window.

edits.before: Gate-poke him out and hammer the Permafrost dive. Track Permafrost before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Gate-poke her out and hammer the Arctic Assault dive. Track her 18s Q before every commit and keep the wave on your side.

edits.before: Cannon-Q connects, then swap to Hammer so your first hit shreds her armor and MR, and Hyper Charge or a follow-up Thundering Blow cashes in the burst. Her Frost passive only stacks for HER stuns and does nothing to answer ranged poke, so she farms at a health deficit.
edits.after: Cannon-Q connects, then swap to Hammer so your first hit shreds her armor and MR, and Hyper Charge or a follow-up Thundering Blow cashes in the burst. Fury of the North (P) gives Frost Armor and slow immunity, so it eats the To the Skies! slow but never the poke.

edits.before: Cannon-Q into a swap that shreds her armor and MR chunks her on any step-up, and her Frost passive only stacks for her own stuns, never answering your poke.
edits.after: Cannon-Q into a swap that shreds her armor and MR chunks her on any step-up, and Frost stacks are hers alone -- they arm Permafrost, never answering your poke.

edits.before: Hold Thundering Blow (Hammer E) as a peel: knock her back when she charges in on Arctic Assault or commits to a Glacial Prison engage
edits.after: Hold Thundering Blow (Hammer E) as peel: knock her back when she charges on Arctic Assault, an 18s cooldown at rank 1, or commits Glacial Prison

notes: focus.text still reads 'Sejuani Permafrost' with letters ['E'] — Permafrost is a 1.5s cooldown and is the wrong thing to track; it should be Arctic Assault (Q). I did not edit it because focus.letters is an array and changing text alone would leave the letter badge wrong. Sides deliberately left matching the already-audited mirror at audits/top/sejuani__jayce.json even though the packet's reference chart differs.
